verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced inside Remote itself. The official MCP server [remote-docs-15] and the agent skills plugin [remote-docs-17] let external AI clients such as Claude Code or Cursor query live Remote data. That is an external-client route to AI answers, adjacent to but not the same as in-product AI insights, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
